stemMd: What limited the group after the new supermarket joined?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A refusal by every volunteer to work.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A legal ban on all household deliveries.

options.label: D
options.textMd: A lack of any interested households.

explanationMd: The passage explicitly identifies storage and transport as the bottleneck. More donations did not automatically translate into useful deliveries because the intermediate handling capacity was insufficient.

distractorRationale.a: The volunteers observed and responded to the problem.
distractorRationale.d: The problem described is spoilage before distribution.
